limits: Specific retained-gel prototype geometry; actual silicone, bond thickness, clamping and replacement behavior require physical acceptance.
The lip leaves a nominal 0.05 mm rear-flange clearance. Measure the cured flange and seating rather than assuming preload.
The blue-light/white-coating/marker strategy is not a calibrated photometric normal or pressure map.
Frame/gel edge contacts can bypass the optical sensing area and must be included in the contact/force comparison.
Thread geometry, actual drive fit, stiffness, force performance and optical quality remain unqualified.
